first_ci.failure: Existing real-Qwen VFold decode tests: the finish hook did not receive the renamed cache keyword.

cause: Attention now passes cache rather than past_key_values. The post-attention hook only recognized the old name, leaving paired values pending before decode.
fix: Accept a non-None cache first, otherwise the legacy past_key_values; never test an empty cache by truthiness. Do not merge before attention consumes the full current values.
regression: Both keyword spellings use a real torch Module and actual value-bank lifecycle; original random-initialized Qwen CPU logits/cache assertions remain unweakened. Ten local VFold tests passed.
gpu_scope: Separate source-frozen small CUDA tensor regression executes the actual finish hook and value banks for both spellings and prefill/decode with three seeds. It is not an HF/Qwen GPU forward or a full VFold experiment; no Transformers/checkpoint download is required.
